reference_answer: At the pinned commit core.run_one handles run directory, read-only snapshot export, CLI session phases, event offsets, answer extraction, workspace digest, usage and metrics in one function. A sound code refactor moves workspace lifecycle into a small internal boundary while retaining run_one API and metrics/events paths, leaves adapter event decoding in adapters.py, and preserves the two-phase standardized continuation. A behavior-preserving alternative is a context manager or helper called by run_one. Tests should cover pinned snapshot cleanup on success and failure, unchanged event offsets and answer/status handling, and the existing 15 runner tests. Do not modify IG prompts or arm models.
